elements_selected.content: Create comprehensive integration tests for all reason commands per TEST-026 through TEST-037. Use a test vault fixture (tests/fixtures/reason-vault/) with known SPL content designed to exercise: basic extraction (single block, multiple blocks, HTML comment exclusion, standalone .spl), theory construction (multi-file, parse errors, provenance), reasoning (penguin/bird scenario, defeated conclusions), explanation (proof trees, defeat chains, unknown literal), what-if (add fact, verify no side effects), why-not (missing preconditions, defeated), require (missing facts, already provable, impossible), conflicts (ambiguous, resolved), export (SPL with provenance, JSON), cross-referencing (links --with-conclusions), and caching (cache hit, invalidation). Each test invokes zetl as a binary via assert_cmd and validates JSON output structure and values.
